description: Lists every domain and card this connection serves, each with one sentence, and count, how many there are. against_measurement names the evidence behind the model, in one of three words: "compared with measurement" (a real object; its description says what it was fitted on, what it was compared with outside the fit and within what, the gap, and where it refuses), "held to a reference calculation" (compared with a published calculation), or "company specimen" (an object the company specified, every constant stated). The numbers say how good it is.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Returns every domain/card pair.
